## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Bǐqiū tīngshī jīng* (T504) is a one-fascicle short sūtra translated by [曇無蘭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%87%E7%84%A1%E8%98%AD) Tánwúlán — also written as [竺曇無蘭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AB%BA%E6%9B%87%E7%84%A1%E8%98%AD) (cf. *Ānán qī mèng jīng* [KR6i0124](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0124) which uses the longer form). The protagonist *Tīngshī bǐqiū* 聽施比丘 is a monk whose name means "Heard-of-Giving" (Sanskrit *Śrutadāna*).

**Abstract**

A short Hīnayāna avadāna sūtra on a monk who exemplifies the perfection of giving. Translation falls within Tánwúlán's Eastern Jìn period (381–395 CE).
